title: In the age of big data and AI: do we still need chemical bonds?
summary: The study finds that Allegro/MACE embeddings encode tested chemical-bond descriptors and that adding descriptors improves prediction of selected material properties. It does not claim a new bonding law or descriptor. The result is reported in the arXiv preprint. Affiliation was not stated in the reviewed material. It does not establish generalization beyond the reported setting or prospective real-world benefit.
